items.heading: Cevapi
details: Key ingredients: minced beef and lamb, onion, somun bread, kajmak
Mix minced beef and lamb with onion and a little baking soda.
Shape into small finger-sized sausages.
Grill over high heat until well charred outside and juicy inside.
Serve stuffed into warm somun bread with chopped onion and kajmak.

items.heading: Bosnian Burek
details: Key ingredients: phyllo dough, ground beef, onion, oil
Season ground beef with onion, salt and pepper for the filling.
Roll the filling inside long strips of phyllo dough.
Coil the filled strips into a spiral in a round baking pan.
Bake until deeply golden and crisp on top.
